hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] && [ -n "$repo_root" ] && [ -n "$file" ]; then case "$file" in "$repo_root"/*) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Direct edits to main are blocked — CLAUDE.md requires feature branches + PRs, even for small fixes. Create a branch first.\"}}" ;; esac; fi

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */wrangler.jsonc|wrangler.jsonc) text=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '[.tool_input.old_string, .tool_input.new_string, .tool_input.content] | map(select(. != null)) | join("\n")' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$text" | grep -q 'LOGBOOK_KV'; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"wrangler.jsonc's KV namespace id is managed by infra.yml (Terraform + bot PR, see #182) — manual edits fight that automation.\"}}"; fi ;; esac
